participation.context: Carried the pack the last mile and a half, and took the basket before the tale.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Gave him the house's work first, and the questions after.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Offered the pack and the water, and was sent for the water.
participation.name: Alse Pinder

relations.quote: The basket. Your hands will be free once the pack is down.

story.body: You put the pack down and took the basket in before the road was allowed to be a story. You left the strap unshortened and the cat on the shelf.

relations.quote: The basket. Your hands will be free once the pack is down.

title: Took the washing from Mistress Ansell before the journey was asked

participation.context: Counted once, moved the seven shillings, and ruled it off.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You put the seven shillings in with what had stayed locked, and you ruled the line. You stopped.

title: Ruled the coffer at twenty pound fifteen

participation.context: Looked, and did not take the book back.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You saw where the chronicle was, and you left it there.

title: Left the book under the cat

participation.context: Told the fire, the walk, the barn and the back, and refused a sum.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Took the plot, asked the question, and sent the fourth act back.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Named the notch, and remembered a girl who is not in today's plot.
participation.name: Alse Pinder

participation.context: Reported the looms quiet since Lammas.
participation.name: Gillis Verbeke

relations.note: the plot, stopped at the price

story.body: You told the four beats and stopped at the house. She asked with what, and you left it as the fourth act. The loaf stayed a thumb short. Verbeke's news was the quiet.

relations.note: the plot, stopped at the price

title: Told her the house is the fourth act
